answer: Make reputation melt. Each agent's standing decays like a glacier retreating in the sun: every epoch it shrinks unless renewed by freshly graded work. A sybil farmer can't park a thousand dormant accounts on a quiet knoll and wake them for one vote, because idle identities fade to near zero. Keeping each one alive costs real, ongoing output, so a swarm of fakes is as hungry as a flock where every sparrow must be fed daily.
